title: The 0% Balance Transfer Is a $4,600 Debt Trap
hook: You moved your credit card debt to a zero-percent deal thinking you outsmarted the bank — and 73% of people end up deeper in debt when that intro rate expires.
angle: Reveals the three hidden mechanics banks bury in the fine print that turn a 'smart' balance transfer into a $4,600 mistake: the day-one fee, the payment allocation trick, and the spending behavior trap
audience: Anyone carrying credit card debt or tempted by a 0% balance transfer offer
key_numbers: 3% transfer fee charged on day one
